assumptions.reference: same seven-quality advanced pond, cap triangular(.85,1,1.15), birth 4cm, T80 1/2/4/5/7/10/14d
assumptions.successes: 20/hour for 24h, externally fixed; relative probability unchanged
assumptions.refill: <=40 refill 80 hourly, day-end refill 100 takes priority, existing quality-deficit weights relative to 100
assumptions.stages: independent mixture per incoming fish; age uniform 0-.2*T80 / .2-.8*T80 / .8-1.5*T80; birth != entry
assumptions.excludes: spot isolation, migration, hook occupation, nutrition, explicit escape growth, tackle failure, species group fit and +/-10% individual biases
